questions.cardText:
[Religious Studies] According to Mayan mythology, what were humans created from?
A. Maize  B. Beans  C. Clay
Answer: A. According to Mayan mythology, after initial failures using mud and wood, humans were ultimately created from maize. For this reason, maize is not only a staple food but also holds sacred significance in Mayan culture.
questions.de: Woraus wurden laut der Schöpfungsgeschichte der Maya im Popol Vuh die ersten echten Menschen geschaffen, nach misslungenen Versuchen mit Lehm und Holz?
questions.en: According to the Maya creation story in the Popol Vuh, from what were the first true humans made after failed attempts with mud and wood?

timeline.labelEn: The K'iche' Maya Popol Vuh is written down in alphabetic script (dated between 1554 and 1558)
timeline.labelDe: Das Popol Vuh der K'iche'-Maya wird in Alphabetschrift niedergeschrieben (datiert zwischen 1554 und 1558)

questions.notes: Popol Vuh Book Four: humans are successfully created from maize (white and yellow corn).

questions.cardText:
[Physiology and Anatomy] What type of tissue primarily composes the iris in the human eye?
A. Muscle tissue
B. Nervous tissue
C. Connective tissue
Answer: C. The iris is moved by the iris sphincter muscle, but the majority of the iris is comprised of a fibrovascular layer of cells, or connective tissue.
questions.de: Aus welcher Gewebeart besteht das Stroma, die vordere Hauptschicht der Regenbogenhaut des menschlichen Auges?
questions.en: What type of tissue forms the stroma, the main front layer of the iris of the human eye?

timeline.labelEn: The 20th edition of Gray's Anatomy describes the stroma of the iris
timeline.labelDe: Die 20. Auflage von Gray's Anatomy beschreibt das Stroma der Iris

questions.notes: Wikipedia: the stroma is the 'connective and vascular tissue of the iris', a fibrovascular layer to which the sphincter and dilator muscles connect. Timeline: the article's text comes from Gray's Anatomy (1918).
